title: Consume the current ETF owner contract with strict as-of eligibility
objective: Consume the current ETF owner contract with strict as-of eligibility. Preserve existing owner semantics and historical evidence.

evidence.summary: Independent findings and corrected external-audit claims.
Read-only probes with synthetic temporary fixtures; no paid API calls.

reproduction: Run validate_owner_record against current DAILY_SETTLED_ETF_CALIBRATION_v2 captures. All are rejected because the adapter accepts only v1 and the old source identity. Test the real current owner metadata plus synthetic v1/v2, revision and as-of boundary fixtures. Historical partially known rows must remain explicitly ineligible.

positive: Fully known, hash-valid current v2 owner evidence can be read without weakening parity, finality, authority or source checks.
Select the latest eligible session known at the as-of time, then the latest eligible revision of that session.
Legacy supported evidence is handled deliberately; excluded rows have explicit diagnostic reasons.
negative: Unknown cells, false parity, bad hashes, non-finite totals, future knowledge or unknown source contracts cannot become eligible.
A late backfill of an older session cannot displace a newer eligible session. Preserve historical records; do not fetch restricted data or change source policy.

forbidden_changes: restricted provider values in public artifacts
